description: Use for questions like 'is my stack secure?' or 'do we have vulnerable packages?'. Checks a list of exact installed package versions against public security advisories. Read them from the project's lockfiles, including transitive packages. Up to 500 per call; call again for more. verdict is yes, no or unknown; unknown means the check was incomplete, so never report it as safe. Does not cover OS packages, Docker base images or your own code. Use check_runtime for Node.js and PHP versions.

ecosystem.description: php, npm, python, go, rust, ruby, java or dotnet

name: check_packages
title: Is my stack secure?
